description: Use this when a visitor asks what park tickets cost at a supported resort for a start date within the next year (walt-disney-world, disneyland-resort, universal-orlando, universal-studios-hollywood). Returns the prices Disney or Universal showed Parky on its last check. Parky cannot sell or book tickets.

date.description: Ticket start date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

resort.description: Resort key or shorthand: wdw, dlr, uor or ush.

name: parky_get_ticket_prices
title: Get ticket prices
